queer_characters.name: Andres Valdez
queer_characters.notes: Described as gay; dates Juan Carlos and later enters a lavender marriage with Tati to escape an arranged heterosexual marriage, a plotline treated as part of the comedic ensemble rather than a punchline.

queer_characters.name: Juan Carlos
queer_characters.notes: Explicitly identified as Andres's gay boyfriend from a wealthy cookie-empire family.

queer_characters.name: Tati
queer_characters.notes: Enters a non-romantic lavender marriage with Andres per the source, but the text does not state Tati's own sexual orientation; her queerness is not supported and this is only a tentative reading of her involvement in the arrangement.
queer_characters.contest_notes: The source describes Tati participating in a marriage of convenience but gives no indication of her own identity; her inclusion as a queer character is unsupported by the text.

queer_creators.name: Julio Torres
